entities.name: Docktown
entities.description: The harbor district of Cabal City in Otaria on Dominaria, dangerous and crowded.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The city of which Docktown was the harbor district.

entities.name: Virot Maglan
entities.description: Armed with deathtouch powers from Kuberr, he killed the patrons of the Ilyssa tavern.

entities.name: Vinyata Maglan
entities.description: Virot's sister, who helped him kill the tavern's patrons.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: The source of Virot Maglan's deathtouch powers.

entities.name: Ilyssa family
entities.description: A family that kept a tavern in Docktown.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A faction whose first unofficial member was the Ilyssa tavern owner.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: Usurped rulership of the Cabal in 4305 AR and lost control of the Mirari's power.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Fought Chainer in a pit fight, together with the Order.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The event in 4305 AR in which Cabal City was overrun by dementia creatures.

events.summary: Virot Maglan brings his sister Vinyata to Docktown to demonstrate his deathtouch powers.
events.quote: brought his sister Vinyata Maglan to Docktown to offer her a demonstration

events.summary: Virot and Vinyata kill everyone in the Ilyssa tavern except the owner, who begged for his life.
events.quote: he and Vinyata killed everyone there except a single except the tavern owner, who begged for his life

events.summary: The tavern owner is spared if he gives up his Ilyssa name and obeys Virot, becoming the Cabal's first unofficial member.
events.quote: This unnamed tavern owner was thus the very first unofficial member of the Cabal

events.summary: In 4305 AR, Cabal City is overrun by dementia creatures during the Battle for the Mirari as Chainer usurps the Cabal.
events.quote: Chainer usurped rulership of the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch to Aphetto

events.summary: Chainer loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl and the Order; the ruined city is abandoned by the Cabal.
events.quote: the ruined city was completely abandoned by the Cabal

relations.quote: brought his sister Vinyata Maglan to Docktown
Docktown was the harbor district of Cabal City

relations.note: They fought in a pit fight.
relations.quote: in a pit fight against Kamahl and the Order
